fields.name: Reopen
fields.doc: Reopen clears a dismissed duplicate so it needs attention again.

fields.name: Notify
fields.doc: Notify asks for the OS notification even while the setting is off, for sources the user explicitly watches.

name: Indicator
desc: Indicator is the title-line mark: lit while any item needs attention.

name: Row
desc: Row is the list shape: the item plus derived display fields.

name: StubTodo
desc: StubTodo stands in for a B-13 todo while the todos unit is not wired; the todos import migrates these rows.

fields.name: Provenance
fields.doc: Provenance is kept in the private metadata beside the capture (B-28).

fields.name: Defaults
fields.doc: settings-table defaults by section then key; never written by the app

name: AddArgs
desc: AddArgs saves one item another unit already knows, such as a starred document. An item with the same kind, text and owner is updated, not repeated.

fields.name: Provenance
fields.doc: Provenance: the turn, pane, task and project the item was extracted in (B-28).

name: ListOptions
desc: PaneScope is independent of the work scope: all panes still obey the pin.

name: Provenance
desc: Provenance says where a record came from: the turn that produced it, the pane it was on, the task and project that pane was assigned to, and for git things the commit, branch and PR. Every row an agent or a check produces carries one, filled at write time (B-28).

name: ScopeSet
desc: ScopeSet is a resolved snapshot; membership never reads storage.

name: Document
desc: Document is one agent-written md or html file. ID is the review document id, so the same file written under two tasks is two documents.

name: Live
desc: Live is the pane that runs `glow -tl` on a document.

name: StarArgs
desc: StarArgs toggles the star when Starred is omitted.

name: State
desc: State is what the unit stores per document. ContextID is the context item a star created; Live names the glow pane that live mode reuses.

name: Download
desc: Download is one entry of the downloads directory. Subdirectories are one row each and are not walked. ID is the absolute path.

name: Seen
desc: Seen is keyed by path and modification time, so a file replaced under the same name shows as unread again.

name: Runner
desc: Runner owns one subscription and serializes each handler independently. Events and their Data maps must not be mutated after publication.

name: Clock
desc: Clock tracks activity independently of page state or redraws. Do not copy it.

name: CheckResult
desc: CheckResult is what the lookup reports to a schedule.

name: MyPR
desc: MyPR is one of the user's open PRs or drafts, with what the last poll saw.

name: PRRow
desc: PRRow is the page shape: the PR plus a status line.

name: SearchResult
desc: SearchResult is one `gh search prs` row, the fields the check asks for.

name: Settings
desc: Settings drive the queries. ReviewQuery and OncallQuery are raw `gh search prs` terms appended to the search; the oncall criteria are a setting, not code.

name: State
desc: State remembers the last check for the page and the CLI.

name: Commit
desc: Commit is a commit the mtm saw made, linked to the turn that made it and, through the pane's assignment, to the task and project.

fields.name: Provenance
fields.doc: Provenance links the entry to its turn, pane, task and project (B-28).

name: PR
desc: PR is a pull request opened from a branch the mtm knows.

name: Trace
desc: Trace is the chain for any row id: PR → commits → turn → task → project.

name: TraceLink
desc: TraceLink is one hop of a provenance chain.

name: Turn
desc: Turn is one delivered user request through a terminal agent answer. A zero CompletedAt records the start; completion appends a separate immutable row.

name: HarnessConfig
desc: HarnessConfig is what mtm does so one harness sees the mtm server: extra arguments on the agent command, or a config file merged with a mtm entry.

name: Identity
desc: Identity is who is talking: the pane and what it is assigned to.

fields.name: Bound
fields.doc: a pane is known; tools that need one refuse otherwise

name: Paths
desc: Paths tell a configured harness how to start this same binary against the same database and daemon.

name: Tool
desc: Tool is one MCP tool: a thin wrapper over an existing command or read. Command names the bus command a passthrough tool wraps; such a tool is listed only while that command is registered, so tools for units that have not merged yet appear the moment they do.

fields.name: Provenance
fields.doc: Provenance: the turn and pane that wrote the note, on top of its owner (B-28).

name: Settings
desc: Settings is the oncall window. Start is the Monday the week starts (YYYY-MM-DD, local time); Weeks is how many weeks from there. Mode "on" or "off" overrides the dates.

name: View
desc: View is the settings row plus whether the window is active now.

fields.name: StateAt
fields.doc: Unix ms the agent entered State, from the daemon

name: StuckMatch
desc: StuckMatch is a pane a rule matched, with the action item it raised.

name: StuckRule
desc: StuckRule is one detection rule and its threshold in seconds.

fields.name: ID
fields.doc: "same-state" | "waiting-input"

name: Owner
desc: Owner is what a pane is assigned to and where it works.

name: Action
desc: Action is a keyed operation in one mode. Does is always human prose; Command names the bus command the key runs, and is empty for keys the UI handles.

name: Concept
desc: Concept is executable CLI metadata, also used to generate concept docs. Commands maps a concept's public verb to its registered bus command name.

fields.name: Unscoped
fields.doc: Unscoped loads choices independently of the current pin; previews keep their scope.

fields.name: Kind
fields.doc: Kind names the field's value kind (task, parent, project, directory, bool, ...); the forms engine derives source, completion, creation and validation from it. Empty falls back to Type, then Source.

fields.name: Parent
fields.doc: Parent names the field holding this record's parent: picking this field sets that one, and that one's value scopes this field's choices.

fields.name: Exclude
fields.doc: Exclude names a field whose record, and its descendants, this field never lists (a task is never its own parent).

name: Registry
desc: Registry is safe for concurrent registration and reads. Definitions and their nested slices/maps are immutable after Add; readers must not mutate them.

fields.name: Provenance
fields.doc: Provenance of the turn or document: its turn, pane, task and project (B-28).

name: OnResult
desc: OnResult chains a prompt when a lookup finds something.

name: Row
desc: Row is the list shape: the schedule plus derived display fields.

name: Run
desc: Run says what a schedule does when it is due.

fields.name: Target
fields.doc: Target is the prompt destination: {"window": id} for an existing pane, otherwise prompts.StartSpec fields (session, agent, cwd, name, ...).

name: RunRecord
desc: RunRecord is one occurrence: duration and outcome, kept in history.

fields.name: Kind
fields.doc: Flat form fields: kind, text, command, window build Run when run is absent.

name: Choice
desc: Choice is one accepted value of a setting and what it means.

name: Definition
desc: Definition declares a known setting: its type, default and whether a service needs it before a lookup may run.

fields.name: Type
fields.doc: text | bool | number | list

fields.name: Required
fields.doc: human label shown as "needs: <label>"

fields.name: Choices
fields.doc: Choices are the only accepted values of a text setting, each with a one-line description; the section form offers them as options.

name: Need
desc: Need is a required setting that is still empty.

name: Section
desc: Section groups the effective rows of one section.

name: Setting
desc: Setting is one stored row. ID is "section.key".

name: View
desc: View is the effective row the shells read: the stored value, else the default. Title, Status and Text feed the generic rail and detail renderers.

name: Message
desc: Message is one captured Slack message: what the MCP search or the agent reports, with the permalink the action item opens.

name: Queries
desc: Queries says what the next check looks at.

name: Row
desc: Row is the page shape: the message, or the settings summary row first.

name: Settings
desc: Settings are the slack-specific knobs; the oncall window, channels and tag live in the oncall unit and are shown here too.

name: View
desc: View is what `mtm slack settings` prints: settings plus the oncall window.

name: Table
desc: Table describes ownership and the version of a unit's JSON row format. Key names the logical key field; Put receives the storage key explicitly.

name: Tx
desc: Tx grants access only to the tables named in Store.Tx. Use its methods, not Store methods, inside a transaction callback.

name: Item
desc: Item is one `### B-nn` heading with its field line, body and notes.

fields.name: Body
fields.doc: the text between the field line and the notes, trimmed

name: Todo
desc: Todo is a parsed todo.md kept as lines so edits touch only the item they change.

fields.name: Kind
fields.doc: record kind in the form's graph; labels above it

fields.name: Path
fields.doc: record kind in the form's graph; labels above it

name: FieldStyles
desc: FieldStyles is how one field row draws in one focus state.

name: Row
desc: Row is one field as the list layout shows it, independent of styling.

fields.name: State
fields.doc: "set" | "default" | "new" | "empty" | "error"

name: Theme
desc: Theme is the list layout's presentation, kept apart from layout and behaviour: a focused and a blurred style per part of a row, and the form-wide title, status, option and help styles.

name: Command
desc: Bubble Tea releases input for Exec. Run joins its sole reader before returning. Only the controller loop calls Render, writes input, or changes the active pane.

name: Promoted
desc: Promoted is what todos.promote returns: the new task and the closed todo.

name: Todo
desc: Todo is lighter than a task: no project required, no panes, a priority and free text, promotable to a task. Notes live on the row until promotion moves them to the task. ExternalID keeps the `B-nn` id of an imported item so a second import updates instead of duplicating.

fields.name: Provenance
fields.doc: Provenance: the turn and pane that added the todo (B-28).

name: TreeDraft
desc: Adds name new tasks with draft: references; new parents precede their children. Each sibling group containing an addition supplies its complete final order. ProjectAdds are created before any task, so a root add may name one.

name: TreeProjectAdd
desc: TreeProjectAdd names a new project with a draft: reference that adds and sibling orders may use as their project_id. It is created without a repository; one is attached later through work.set-tree.
